title: The holiday plugin no longer shows language identifiers, making it hard to distinguish between otherwise identically-named entries
line: The Holidays settings page now shows the language of each region in countries with several holiday files, like Belgium (French, Dutch, Walloon).
explanation: kholidays ships one holiday file per language for countries like Belgium, Bangladesh or Serbia, all with the same name and often the same description. The Holidays page lists kholidays' HolidayRegionsModel, which only exposed region, name and description, so these appeared as identical rows. kholidays' model now has a 'language' role (the file's language name from QLocale, with Latin/Cyrillic script and the Serbian Ijekavian variants spelled out) and a 'hasLanguageVariants' role (the country has more than one file); the Holidays page shows the language at the start of the subtitle for those regions.

commits.message:
HolidayRegionsModel: add language roles

Countries with one holiday file per language, like Belgium or Serbia,
have regions with the same name and description. Add a role with the
name of the file's language and one telling if its country has several.

BUG: 482125

plasmacalendarintegration: show the language of holiday regions

Countries with one holiday file per language, like Belgium or Serbia,
were listed as several identical rows in the Holidays settings page. The
language name from the region model is now shown in their subtitle.

BUG: 482125

patches.diff:
From 25e750c33208daf965ffaa52fff1459463dbb355 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:51:46 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] plasmacalendarintegration: show the language of holiday
 regions

Countries with one holiday file per language, like Belgium or Serbia,
were listed as several identical rows in the Holidays settings page. The
language name from the region model is now shown in their subtitle.

BUG: 482125
---
 plasmacalendarintegration/HolidaysConfig.qml | 4 +++-
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/plasmacalendarintegration/HolidaysConfig.qml b/plasmacalendarintegration/HolidaysConfig.qml
index 8d5335af54..75967f0f2d 100644
--- a/plasmacalendarintegration/HolidaysConfig.qml
+++ b/plasmacalendarintegration/HolidaysConfig.qml
@@ -64,11 +64,13 @@ KCMUtils.ScrollViewKCM {
             required property string region
             required property string name
             required property string description
+            required property string language
+            required property bool hasLanguageVariants
 
             property string subtitle
 
             text: name
-            subtitle: description
+            subtitle: [hasLanguageVariants ? language : "", description].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")
 
             checked: configHelper.selectedRegions.includes(region)
             width: ListView.view.width
-- 
2.53.0
